questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The coefficient of restitution for a perfectly elastic collision is:
questions.explanation: e is the ratio of the relative velocity of separation to that of approach. It is 1 for a perfectly elastic collision and 0 for a perfectly inelastic one, where the bodies stick together.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 5: Work, Energy and Power

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A wire of a given material breaks under a certain load. If a wire of the same material but twice the length and the same radius is taken, the breaking load will be:
questions.explanation: Breaking stress is a property of the material and acts over the cross-section, so the breaking load depends only on the area and not at all on the length of the wire.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 8: Mechanical Properties of Solids

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The net magnetic flux through any closed surface is always zero. This is because:
options: Magnetic field lines are always straight
Isolated magnetic poles do not exist, so field lines form closed loops
questions.explanation: Every line that enters a closed surface must leave it, since poles always occur in pairs. This is Gauss's law for magnetism, and it is why a broken magnet gives two complete magnets.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 5: Magnetism and Matter

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: All three carbon-oxygen bonds in the carbonate ion CO₃²⁻ are found to be of equal length. This is explained by:
options: Resonance, the real structure being a hybrid of several canonical forms
questions.explanation: No single Lewis structure fits, because each would need one double and two single bonds. The delocalised pi electrons spread the double bond character equally over all three bonds.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 4: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The solubility product of a sparingly soluble salt AB₂, whose solubility is s mol per litre, is given by:
questions.explanation: AB₂ gives one A²⁺ of concentration s and two B⁻ of concentration 2s, so Ksp = s × (2s)² = 4s³.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Haloalkanes are almost insoluble in water although they are polar. The main reason is that haloalkanes:
options: Cannot form hydrogen bonds with water, so breaking water's own hydrogen bonds is not compensated
questions.explanation: Dissolving would need the water-water hydrogen bonds to be replaced by new ones, and a C-X group cannot form them, so the energy balance is unfavourable.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 6: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Annual rings seen in the cross-section of a temperate tree trunk are produced because:
options: The cambium is active only once in the life of the tree
The cambium is more active in spring and less in autumn, giving alternating early and late wood
The bark peels off every year
questions.explanation: Spring wood has wide, thin walled vessels and autumn wood narrow, thick walled ones, so one ring marks one year and the rings can be counted to estimate a tree's age.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 6: Anatomy of Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In the secondary treatment of sewage, the activated sludge stage works because:
options: Aerobic microbes grow vigorously and consume the organic matter, lowering the BOD
The water is simply filtered through sand
All microbes are killed by chlorine
questions.explanation: Air is pumped through the effluent so flocs of aerobic bacteria and fungi multiply. A part of the sludge is returned as inoculum and the rest digested anaerobically to yield biogas.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 8: Microbes in Human Welfare

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Rhodopsin, the purple red pigment that makes vision in dim light possible, is present in the:
questions.explanation: Rods contain rhodopsin, which is made from vitamin A, so a deficiency of that vitamin causes night blindness. Cones hold photopsins and give colour vision in bright light.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 18: Neural Control and Coordination

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Parturition, the act of childbirth, is induced by a neuroendocrine mechanism in which:
options: Oxytocin causes uterine contractions, which in turn stimulate more oxytocin release
FSH triggers the uterus to contract
questions.explanation: This is a rare positive feedback loop: the signals build on each other until the baby is delivered, after which the stimulus and the loop end.
